# Pinned source import

Source reference snapshot copied from `andymcca/lr-gpsp-nspire` commit `2ddeb23b565cab84e20278bb73ed76f3d91b25f5` (matches the supplied handoff's pinned source).

**Important:** The 16 KiB `libretro-gpsp/bios/open_gba_bios.bin` GPL-licensed open replacement BIOS binary is omitted from this text-only API import. Do not treat this folder as standalone-build complete. The Run007 workflow clones the complete pinned upstream source directly and remains the supported build path.

The SDK executables (`nspire-gcc`, `nspire-ld`, `genzehn`) are also not stored here. They come from the shared Docker image.
